title: Zeteo’s (Fake) Democratic Consultant Is Back — And Already Working on 2028!
author: Team Zeteo
content:
The 2028 presidential primary in the US is only two years away, which means
it's basically already started. From the slew of
[political](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/646296/young-man-in-a-
hurry-by-gavin-newsom/)
[memoirs](https://www.harpercollins.com/products/where-we-keep-the-light-josh-
shapiro?variant=44415011684386) hitting the bookshelves to the myriad
[podcast](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jraRu00p5mc)
[appearances](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bgx7GvYSq64), most of the
Democratic hopefuls are already throwing their hats in the ring.

So who better to weigh in on the top contenders than **Zeteo 's** very own
(fake) Democratic consultant? In this new and hilarious parody video, **Zeteo
's** **Frank Cappello** imagines what members of the consultant class _really_
think of each candidate -- and who will offer the biggest payday.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Will it be California Governor and **" movie president"** Gavin Newsom? What
about Pete Buttigieg, who in just 15 years of public service has shown almost
as much backbone as Bernie Sanders' cardboard standee? Or perhaps Kamala **"
Third Time's the Charm"** Harris will give it another go.

After all, with the 2024 election costing upwards of[ $5
billion](https://www.opensecrets.org/elections-overview/cost-of-election), the
consultants are the real winners anyway.

_Zeteo 's Frank Cappello and Liam Mann contributed to this video._
